verdict.rationale: Antigravity 2.0 is a downloadable desktop app that serves as a 'central command center' for launching, monitoring and orchestrating multiple agents in parallel, with Git worktree isolation for each. It also has visual diff review: a Review Changes surface and file diff viewers with a 'Hide Whitespace Changes' filter, plus code-diff Artifacts you can comment on. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a side-by-side or split-pane layout for concurrent sessions, and independent hands-on corroboration of the diff-review UI.
